mainText: This is the Gaza Dispatch audio briefing for June 17, 2026. Here are the key source-backed developments from today's edition. 1. Israeli drone strike kills 2 beachgoers, wounds 6 in southern Gaza. Attack on crowded beachfront in Khan Younis targets civilians seeking relief from summer heat, as. Israel's ceasefire violations continue across enclave. This was reported by Anadolu Agency. 2. Death toll in Gaza since 'ceasefire' with Israel goes past 1,000. Israel approves Jewish religious school construction in occupied West Bank's Hebron. Decision marks 1st implementation of Israel's move to take away Palestinian municipality's building and planning authority, in violation of Hebron Agreement. This was reported by Anadolu Agency. 4.
